entities.summary: Saori Obata is a former tennis player from Japan. She turned professional in April 1996, and in February 2004, she achieved a career-high singles ranking of 39, and on the same day, she reached her best doubles ranking of 98. Saori Obata was a athletes & competitors from Tokyo (b. 1978-04-23, Tokyo). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
